global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender noodles, topped with halved soft-boiled egg and crisp menma. Fresh green onions crown the bowl, served in a patterned ceramic bowl against a vibrant red background under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim and green dragon motifs, smooth glossy surface, circular shape with decorative pattern.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, rich amber color, glossy surface, thin strands submerged, speckled with seasoning.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange-red yolk with a glossy, slightly runny texture, encased in a firm white shell.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular curved shape.
